exposure: Stainless steel staples for skin closure
outcome: Composite wound complication (superficial or deep separation and infection)
cohort: 242 women with class III obesity (body mass index ≥40 kg/m(2)) undergoing cesarean delivery
finding: There was no difference in composite wound outcome up to 6 weeks postpartum between women who had staples and those who had subcuticular suture skin closure.
